text:
maria: Quick concept Can we make a single visual that stacks latency buckets (p50 / p95 / p99) per model config and overlays unit cost ($/1k tokens)? goal = one hero slide for the webinar + a simplified static for social/blog.

alex: Yes — show hosted vs dedicated side-by-side and add a tiny $$ panel that converts unit cost into monthly bills for 1M / 10M tokens. that helps PMs.

sam: Data needs: runtime team, can you export CSV with model, p50_ms, p95_ms, p99_ms, cost_per_1k_usd, cache_enabled, deploy_type? benchbot: linking latest run.

benchbot: run_id=8812, link=https://bench.internal/runs/8812, fields=[model,p50_ms,p95_ms,p99_ms,cost_per_1k_usd,cache_enabled,deploy_type].

jordan: Suggest a dotted "fallback" trace on the chart to show routing to cheaper model under tail pressure. also annotate where batching/prefix cache shifts p95 -> p50. makes the tradeoffs tangible.

liv: Draft headline options (new wording):
- A: "What latency costs look like in production"
- B: "Keep the tail low, save on tokens"
- C: "Real-world latency vs price: a practical view"
Which should we use for paid vs organic?

alex: Use B for paid (short + benefit), A for organic, C for the webinar description.

maria: Signup routing: add product interest radio (Hosted / Dedicated / Not sure). Rule: if Dedicated OR (Not sure AND company_size > 250) -> tag SDR; otherwise -> marketing nurture. Include a hidden tag for customers who select "Dedicated" so AE gets alerted.

jordan: Also request a single-sentence explainer under the chart: "Benchmarks across common configs — see how batching, caching, and routing change latency and token economics." keep it plain.

sam: Timeline: need final assets by Monday EOD for Tuesday invite. Owners: sam = CSV + fig; liv = copy + image exports; alex = landing + form wiring; jordan = routing + SDR mapping. I'll post a PNG draft by Friday.
maria: Compliance note: add small footnote: "Controlled-benchmark results; real workloads may vary." small gray text. thanks team. :rocket:
